description: This file defines classes related to tracking frequent items in data streams, specifically implementing a modified 'Filtered Space-Saving' algorithm for identifying top-k elements. It contains an internal sealed class 'FrequentEdgeCounter' for counting edges with source and target nodes, as well as an abstract class 'FrequentItemCollection' managing a priority queue with a sketch for approximate counting.

classes.name: FrequentEdgeCounter
classes.description: A class for counting edges with source and target nodes, utilizing a capacity limit and derived from 'FrequentItemCollection'. It provides methods to get keys for edges, clear, and remove edges.

classes.name: FrequentItemCollection`2
classes.description: An abstract generic class implementing a prioritized frequency collection using a d-ary heap and sketch-based approximate counts, suitable for top-k tracking in data streams.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Abstract method to extract a key from an element.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element to the collection, updating counts, inserting new elements, or evicting the least frequent as needed.

methods.name: RemoveCore
methods.description: Removes an element identified by its key from the collection.

methods.name: ClearCore
methods.description: Clears all elements and resets internal data structures.

methods.name: InsertHeap
methods.description: Inserts a new counter into the heap structure.

methods.name: GrowHeap
methods.description: Resizes the internal heap array to accommodate more elements.

methods.name: MoveUpHeap
methods.description: Restores heap order by moving a node up the tree.

methods.name: MoveDownHeap
methods.description: Restores heap order by moving a node down the tree.
